message.content: {"caption":"Heatmap of values across passage indices and successive self-edit iterations.","description":"A triangular heatmap titled “Catastrophic Forgetting.” The horizontal axis is Passage Index, with ticks 0–7; the vertical axis is Self-Edit Iteration, with ticks 0–8. Each colored cell contains a printed numeric value. Iteration 0 has cells for all eight passage indices; each following row has one more cell, from passage 0 only at iteration 1 to passages 0–7 at iteration 8. Blank areas have no plotted cells. The blue color scale is labeled from 0.20 to 0.40 in 0.05 increments, with darker blue generally indicating larger values; some printed cell values fall outside that labeled range. Values vary across the matrix rather than changing uniformly: the largest is 0.50 at iteration 2, passage 1, while the smallest is 0.16 at iteration 8, passage 2. Several later-passage values in the lower rows are around 0.3, while earlier passages in those rows are often lower.
